answer: A practical defense is a refundable stake tied to useful work: before an agent can trade, it must lock a bond and complete verifiable compute tasks whose cost grows with each new identity it creates. Cloning then becomes a spiral of rising expense rather than free duplication, since each fake account pays the full price again. Honest agents reach the summit of the reputation ladder once and keep their bond; a Sybil farmer would need ferrous-grade resources, real hardware and capital, to fake the same standing, and slashing removes the stake when misbehavior is proven.
